news.title: Alphabet or CoreWeave: Which AI Stock Is Better to Buy in a Market Crash?
news.summary: Alphabet and CoreWeave are both positioned to benefit from AI, but one has a much stronger financial foundation.
news.title_zh: Alphabet 或 CoreWeave：市場崩盤時哪檔 AI 股票較適合買進？
news.summary_zh: Alphabet 和 CoreWeave 都有望從 AI 獲益，但其中一家擁有強得多的財務基礎。

news.title: Why Alphabet and Amazon Will Always Need Nvidia
news.summary: Google sells its own TPUs and Amazon pushes Trainium, yet both keep writing NVIDIA enormous checks. One supply bottleneck and one software moat explain why the custom-chip threat may be harder to execute than it looks.
news.title_zh: 為何 Alphabet 和 Amazon 永遠都需要 Nvidia
news.summary_zh: Google 銷售自家 TPU，Amazon 推動 Trainium，但兩者持續開出龐大支票給 NVIDIA。一個供應瓶頸和一個軟體護城河，解釋了為何自研晶片威脅執行起來可能比看起來更難。

news.title: “Five-Nines”: Larry Page Reportedly Sees 99.999% of Compute in Orbit, and Musk Agrees
news.summary: Key TakeawaysInvestor Patrick O’Shaughnessy said he heard secondhand that Larry Page, co-founder of Google and its parent Alphabet, expects 99. 999% of compute to end up in orbit, and Elon Musk called it one of Page’s many accurate predictions.
news.title_zh: 「五個九」：據報 Larry Page 看好 99.999% 算力進入軌道，Musk 表示贊同
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要投資人 Patrick O’Shaughnessy 表示他間接聽聞，Google 聯合創始人暨其母公司 Alphabet 創始人 Larry Page 預期 99。 999% 算力最終將進入軌道，Elon Musk 稱這是 Page 眾多準確預測之一。

news.title: Alphabet Is Set to Become an Even Bigger Anthropic Shareholder After the IPO
news.summary: Does Google's bigger Anthropic stake move the needle for Alphabet? Anthropic's amended S-1 filing shows the size, the price, and the risks.
news.title_zh: Alphabet 有望在 IPO 後成為 Anthropic 更大股東
news.summary_zh: Google 更大的 Anthropic 持股能否為 Alphabet 帶來實質影響？Anthropic 修訂後的 S-1 申報文件揭露了規模、價格與風險。

news.title: Nvidia’s 70% to 80% Margins Are “Like Throwing Chum in the Water,” Says Its Biographer
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNvidia fell 4% on Monday after its board opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang. Nvidia’s 71% gross margin gives its biggest buyers every reason to back cheaper chips, and Anthropic training its AI almost entirely on chips Google designs shows how that can work.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 的 70% to 80% 利潤率「像在水裡撒魚餌」，其傳記作者表示
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Nvidia 在週一下跌 4%，因董事會展開對 CEO 黃仁勳的調查。Nvidia 的 71% 毛利率讓其最大買家有充分理由支持更便宜的晶片，而 Anthropic 幾乎完全使用 Google 設計的晶片訓練 AI，展示了這如何運作。

news.title: Google, Nvidia and Microsoft “Literally Feeding Themselves Money” with $26 Billion Anthropic IPO Buy
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAlphabet’s Google, Nvidia, Microsoft, Broadcom, AMD, Micron and TSMC will buy $26 billion of Anthropic’s shares at its IPO price, on top of an offering of up to $64. 4 billion.
news.title_zh: Google、Nvidia 和 Microsoft 透過 $26 Billion Anthropic IPO 認購「簡直在餵自己錢」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Alphabet 旗下 Google、Nvidia、Microsoft、Broadcom、AMD、Micron 和 TSMC 將以 IPO 價格購買 $26 billion Anthropic 股份，此外還有高達 $64 的發售。 4 billion.

news.title: Tesla Bull Predicts Democrats Will “Block Autonomy,” a Bigger Risk Than Data Centers
news.summary: Key TakeawaysJason Calacanis, a Tesla shareholder, said on This Week in Startups that after the midterms Democrats will “block autonomy,” a bigger risk for tech than data centers. The risk is bigger for Tesla than for Alphabet’s Waymo, since Elon Musk says Cybercab will dominate only where the law allows it, and Tesla is moving Cybertruck out of Giga Texas to build more of them.
news.title_zh: 特斯拉多頭預測民主黨將「封鎖自動駕駛」，風險大於數據中心
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：特斯拉股東傑森·卡拉卡尼斯在《This Week in Startups》節目中表示，中期選舉後民主黨將「封鎖自動駕駛」，這對科技業的風險大於數據中心。由於埃隆·馬斯克表示 Cybercab 只會在法律允許的地方佔據主導地位，因此這項風險對特斯拉的影響大於 Alphabet 旗下的 Waymo，且特斯拉正將 Cybertruck 從 Giga Texas 遷出以增加產量。

news.title: Andrew Ross Sorkin: Anthropic’s IPO Is “the Linchpin” for Amazon, Google and Microsoft
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOn Friday, Bloomberg reported that buyers in Anthropic’s IPO see a valuation as low as $1. 1 trillion.
news.title_zh: 安德魯·羅斯·索金：Anthropic 的 IPO 是亞馬遜、Google 和微軟的「關鍵」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：週五，彭博社報導稱，Anthropic IPO 的買方認為估值低至 $1。 1 trillion.

news.title: Alphabet’s Regulatory Advantage Never Gets Talked About But It Should
news.summary: Every AI data center needs a gigawatt of power, and regulators now decide who gets it. While Alphabet shares slide, the company has quietly been signing nuclear deals that could shape who wins the next decade.
news.title_zh: Alphabet 的監管優勢鮮少被提及，但應該受到關注
news.summary_zh: 每個 AI 數據中心都需要一吉瓦的電力，而監管機構現在決定誰能獲得。當 Alphabet 股價下滑時，該公司一直在悄悄簽署核能協議，這可能決定誰將贏得未來十年。

news.title: Nvidia, Alphabet, and Micron Just Agreed to Buy $26 Billion of Stock in One of Their Biggest Customers
news.summary: Chip and cloud suppliers are now investors in a customer whose spending plans far outrun its revenue.
news.title_zh: Nvidia、Alphabet 和 Micron 同意購買 $26 Billion 股票，投資其最大客戶之一
news.summary_zh: 晶片和雲端供應商現在成為一位客戶的投資人，該客戶的支出計劃遠超其營收。

news.title: Nvidia and Broadcom Are Scaling AI Data Centers With This Growth Stock. Here's Why It Could Soar.
news.summary: The AI trade is suffering, but don't make the mistake of overlooking Alphabet's long-term growth trends.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 和 Broadcom 正與這檔成長股擴展 AI 數據中心。以下是它可能飆升的原因。
news.summary_zh: AI 交易正遭受打擊，但別犯錯忽視 Alphabet 的長期成長趨勢。

news.title: Google, Nvidia and Microsoft Are Among 7 Tech Giants Putting $26 Billion Into Anthropic’s IPO
news.summary: A late-night report promised a $26 billion supplier stampede into Anthropic's IPO, then Anthropic called its own pricing inaccurate. Only one commitment appears in an SEC filing, so which backer holds the real stake?
news.title_zh: Google、Nvidia 和 Microsoft 位於 7 家投資 Anthropic IPO 的科技巨頭之列，投入 $26 Billion
news.summary_zh: 深夜報導稱 $26 billion 供應商蜂擁投資 Anthropic IPO，隨後 Anthropic 稱自家定價不準確。SEC 文件僅顯示一項承諾，究竟哪位支持者持有真實股份？

news.title: Alibaba Prepares Hong Kong IPO For Chip Unit T-Head as China Ramps Up AI Chip Ambitions to Challenge Nvidia
news.summary: Alibaba plans a Hong Kong IPO for chip unit T-Head as it expands AI hardware ambitions amid growing demand for Nvidia chips in China.
news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴準備為晶片部門T-Head在香港進行IPO，隨著中國加大AI晶片雄心以挑戰輝達
news.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴計劃為晶片部門T-Head在香港進行IPO，因其擴大AI硬體雄心，中國對輝達晶片的需求日益增長。

news.title: Trump’s Commerce Dept. Halted a Chip Probe “After Nvidia Intervention.” That’s Nvidia’s Bigger Problem
news.summary: Key TakeawaysThe New York Times reported that a Commerce Department probe into Megaspeed was halted after NVIDIA’s top lawyer named a Trump-nominated official. Megaspeed imported billions of dollars of NVIDIA equipment into Malaysia for data centers serving Chinese clients, including Alibaba.
news.title_zh: 川普商務部叫停晶片調查「在輝達介入後」。這是輝達更大的問題
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點《紐約時報》報導，商務部對Megaspeed的調查在輝達首席律師點名一位川普提名官員後被叫停。Megaspeed進口數十億美元的輝達設備到馬來西亞，為服務中國客戶（包括阿里巴巴）的資料中心提供服務。

news.title: Alibaba advances Hong Kong IPO plans for chip subsidiary T-Head
news.summary: Investing.com -- Alibaba Group (NYSE: BABA) said Tuesday it has received approval from the Hong Kong Stock Exchange to proceed with the proposed spin-off and separate listing of its semiconductor subsidiary T-Head, moving forward with plans to give investors direct exposure to its data-center chip business.
news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴推進晶片子公司T-Head在香港的IPO計劃
news.summary_zh: Investing.com -- 阿里巴巴集團（NYSE: BABA）週二表示，已獲得香港交易所批准，推進其半導體子公司T-Head的擬議分拆和獨立上市，繼續推進讓投資者直接接觸其資料中心晶片業務的計劃。

news.title: Nvidia’s Chinese Clients Will Get Just 1% of $70 Billion in RTX Chip Orders
news.summary: Key TakeawaysChinese AI and cloud firms, Alibaba among them, have ordered about 6 million NVIDIA RTX Pro 5500 chips worth about $70 billion, but expect to get only about 1% of them over the next four months. With too little capacity to go around, NVIDIA is building its most advanced, higher-margin chips first, so China’s orders are left waiting.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 的中國客戶在 RTX 晶片訂單中將僅獲得 1% 之 $70 Billion
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要中國 AI 與雲端企業（包括阿里巴巴）已訂購約 6 million 顆 NVIDIA RTX Pro 5500 晶片，價值約 $70 billion，但預期未來四個月僅能獲得其中約 1%。因產能不足，NVIDIA 優先生產最先進、利潤較高的晶片，導致中國訂單被迫等待。

news.title: Amazon vs. Alibaba: Two E-Commerce Giants, a Big Valuation Gap, but Which Offers More Upside in 2027?
news.summary: Amazon and Alibaba are investing heavily in the future of e-commerce and artificial intelligence, but a substantial valuation gap could make one the more attractive opportunity heading into 2027.
news.title_zh: Amazon vs. Alibaba：兩大電商巨頭，估值差距巨大，但哪一檔在 2027 更具上漲潛力？
news.summary_zh: Amazon 和 Alibaba 正大力投資電商與人工智慧的未來，但龐大的估值落差可能使其中一檔成為進入 2027 時更具吸引力的機會。

news.title: Alibaba vs. Target: Comparing Revenue Trends Between Two Retail Titans
news.summary: Alibaba consistently outpaces Target by billions each quarter, but both reveal identical seasonal patterns that could reshape how investors value growth.
news.title_zh: Alibaba vs. Target：比較兩大零售巨頭的營收趨勢
news.summary_zh: Alibaba 每季持續以數十億美元超越 Target，但兩者呈現相同的季節性模式，可能重塑投資人對成長的估值方式。

news.title: Alibaba Soars 6% as Apple Sets December Launch for Qwen-Powered iPhone AI in China
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAlibaba shares jumped 6% after Apple picked Qwen for its December AI launch in China, while JD. com and PDD Holdings rose on Chinese market support.
news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴飆升 6%，蘋果訂於十二月在中國推出搭載 Qwen 的 iPhone AI
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要阿里巴巴股價跳升 6%，因蘋果選擇 Qwen 作為其十二月在中國的 AI 推出，而京東和拼多多控股因中國市場支持而上漲。

news.title: Apple Made $64.85 Billion in China in 9 Months Without AI. Now Alibaba’s Qwen Is Coming to Siri
news.summary: Key TakeawaysApple will launch its first Apple Intelligence features in mainland China with iOS 27. 3 in December, with Alibaba’s Qwen inside Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence and Baidu also building features for Chinese users.
news.title_zh: 蘋果在中國 $64.85 Billion，在 9 個月內未使用 AI。現在阿里巴巴的 Qwen 即將進駐 Siri
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Apple 將在中國大陸推出其首個 Apple Intelligence 功能，搭配 iOS 27。3 在十二月，阿里巴巴的 Qwen 將內建於 Siri、寫作工具和視覺智能中，百度也在為中國用戶建構功能。

news.summary: Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX - Get Free Report) CEO Gregory Peters sold 27,312 shares of Netflix stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, November 9th. The shares were sold at an average price of $63.62, for a total transaction of $1,737,589.44. news.title: Amazon and Google Win Big From Anthropic IPO
news.summary: If you’re looking for a cheaper way of getting exposure to Anthropic than buying the stock directly, consider Amazon or Google. Anthropic’s updated IPO filing on Tuesday shows just how many shares each of those two tech giants will own in Anthropic, along with how much money they’re making on their early investments in the AI firm. Neither tech giant will own voting shares in Anthropic, so antitrust cops won’t have to worry about their influence over its management. But their stakes are significant. In theory, Amazon could own around 20% of Anthropic’s outstanding shares. But because of a self-imposed ownership cap, Amazon won’t hold more than 12% of Anthropic. The rest of its holdings are convertible notes that can convert to equity over time. Regardless, Amazon’s economic return is pretty damn good. Forgetting about the ownership cap for a minute, Amazon’s entire 20%-or-so stake would be worth about $258 billion at the midpoint of Anthropic’s proposed IPO pricing range. That’s from an investment totaling around $18.6 billion. (Anthropic’s final IPO price may well end up higher than the preliminary range, a Financial Times report tonight suggests).
news.title_zh: 亞馬遜與谷歌從 Anthropic IPO 大賺特賺
news.summary_zh: 若您想以比直接買股票更便宜的方式接觸 Anthropic，不妨考慮亞馬遜或谷歌。Anthropic 週二更新的 IPO 申報文件顯示，這兩大科技巨頭各自將持有多少 Anthropic 股份，以及它們在這家 AI 公司的早期投資賺了多少錢。兩大科技巨頭都不會持有 Anthropic 的有表決權股份，因此反壟斷機構無需擔心它們對管理層的影響力。但它們的股份相當可觀。理論上，亞馬遜可能持有約 20% 的 Anthropic 流通股。但因自我設定的持股上限，亞馬遜持股不會超過 12% 的 Anthropic。其餘持股為可轉換票據，可隨時間轉換為股權。無論如何，亞馬遜的經濟回報相當不錯。暫且不論持股上限，亞馬遜整個約 20% 的股份，按 Anthropic 擬議 IPO 價格區間中點計算，價值約 $258 billion。這源自總計約 $18.6 billion 的投資。（據《金融時報》今晚報導，Anthropic 最終 IPO 價格很可能高於初步區間）。

news.title: Why HubSpot, Snowflake and Others Are Avoiding AI Spending Caps
news.summary: While some companies are curbing employees’ AI use to contain soaring costs, many others in the tech industry are pushing ahead with full-throttle spending. As the chart below shows, large cloud providers including Amazon Web Services and software firms such as Palantir, Snowflake and HubSpot haven’t put firm caps on engineers’ spending as employees use AI coding tools like Anthropic’s Claude Code and OpenAI’s Codex to build apps and features. Neither have the frontier labs themselves. And venture capitalists say many of their portfolio companies are still urging employees to use as much AI as possible.

items.title: Amazon and Google Win Big From Anthropic IPO
items.summary: If you’re looking for a cheaper way of getting exposure to Anthropic than buying the stock directly, consider Amazon or Google. Anthropic’s updated IPO filing on Tuesday shows just how many shares each of those two tech giants will own in Anthropic, along with how much money they’re making on their early investments in the AI firm. Neither tech giant will own voting shares in Anthropic, so antitrust cops won’t have to worry about their influence over its management. But their stakes are significant. In theory, Amazon could own around 20% of Anthropic’s outstanding shares. But because of a self-imposed ownership cap, Amazon won’t hold more than 12% of Anthropic. The rest of its holdings are convertible notes that can convert to equity over time. Regardless, Amazon’s economic return is pretty damn good. Forgetting about the ownership cap for a minute, Amazon’s entire 20%-or-so stake would be worth about $258 billion at the midpoint of Anthropic’s proposed IPO pricing range. That’s from an investment totaling around $18.6 billion. (Anthropic’s final IPO price may well end up higher than the preliminary range, a Financial Times report tonight suggests).

Neither have the frontier labs themselves. And venture capitalists say many of their portfolio companies are still urging employees to use as much AI as possible.

news.summary: A $0 premium and a trusted warehouse brand make Costco's new Medicare Advantage plan an easy yes at 65. The fine print on getting out of it, and a clock that starts on day one, could turn an easy yes into a costly trap.
news.title_zh: 她計劃在 65 加入 Costco 的新 Medicare Advantage 計畫。一旦她的 12 個月試用權結束，Medigap 保險公司可能會詢問健康問題並拒絕她的申請

news.title: A Fund With $4.5 Billion in US Equities Dumps These 3 Stocks
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAlphinity Investment Management sold all of its Costco, American Express and Intuitive Surgical shares in the third quarter, its latest 13F shows. The Costco exit looks smartest: the stock trades at 46x forward earnings with 3% left to analysts’ average target.
news.title_zh: 一隻持有 $4.5 Billion 美股的基金拋售這些 3 股票
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Alphinity Investment Management 在第三季售出所有 Costco、American Express 和 Intuitive Surgical 股份，其最新 13F 顯示。Costco 撤出看起來最明智：該股票以 46x 遠期盈餘交易，距離分析師平均目標價尚有 3%。

news.title: Costco Stock: Earnings Growth Could Shape the Next Big Move
news.summary: Six straight earnings beats have pushed Costco shares up 20% this year, yet a 49x trailing P/E leaves little room for error. One metric could decide whether the rally keeps running or finally stalls.
news.title_zh: Costco 股票：盈利增長可能決定下一波大行情
news.summary_zh: 連續六次盈利超預期推動 Costco 股價今年上漲 20%，但 49x 歷史市盈率留給錯誤的空間很小。一項指標可能決定漲勢是持續還是最終停滯。

news.title: ‘Only Go Into Physical Stores Every Sixth Week’: Clark Howard’s Anti-Impulse Rule as Costco Hits $1,025
news.summary: Clark Howard spent years watching couples bleed money one warehouse trip at a time, and the fix he landed on sounds almost too simple to work. With Costco shares surging past $1,000 and the holiday treasure-hunt season starting, the math behind his rule gets uncomfortable fast.
news.title_zh: 「每六週才進實體店一次」：克拉克·霍華德的反衝動購物規則，正值 Costco 股價衝上 $1,025
news.summary_zh: 克拉克·霍華德花了多年觀察情侶們一次倉儲式購物就大出血，他找到的對策聽起來簡單得幾乎不像會奏效。隨著 Costco 股價衝過 $1,000，假日尋寶季啟動，他規則背後的數學算起來讓人很不舒服。

news.title: In 1975, Sol Price Was Pushed Out of FedMart, the Discount Chain He Founded. The Warehouse Store He Opened Next Became Part of Costco
news.summary: A lawyer-turned-retailer got fired from the discount chain he built over two decades, and the warehouse he opened next with a handful of friends and a converted Hughes property became the blueprint for one of the most powerful retail businesses on the planet.
news.title_zh: 在 1975 年，Sol Price 被踢出他創辦的折扣連鎖 FedMart。他接著開設的倉儲店後來成為 Costco 的一部分
news.summary_zh: 這位從律師轉行的零售商，從他經營了二十多年的折扣連鎖店被解僱，隨後他和幾位朋友利用一處改建的 Hughes 房產開設的倉儲店，成了全球最強大零售企業之一的藍圖。

news.title: Jim Cramer Says Costco Is Still a Great Value. Charlie Munger’s Rule Explains Why
news.summary: Charlie Munger once said Costco is the one stock where you can look past the P/E. After a month-long rally, that exception faces its toughest test yet, and the business and the price may tell two different stories.
news.title_zh: 吉姆·克拉默稱 Costco 仍是超值股。查理·芒格的法則解釋原因
news.summary_zh: 查理·芒格曾說 Costco 是那檔可以不看本益比的股票。經過一個月的漲勢後，這個例外面臨迄今最嚴峻的考驗，基本面與股價可能講述兩個截然不同的故事。

news.title: SpaceX Wins NASA Moon Base Awards, but Government Is “Less Than 10%” of Its Revenue
news.summary: Key TakeawaysSpaceX shares rose about 6% on Monday after NASA named it one of eight companies that can compete for up to $10 billion of lunar delivery work over 10 years. Even if SpaceX won all of it, the contract would pay less per year than SpaceX brought in during an average week of the third quarter.

news.summary: Key TakeawaysSpaceX has reportedly stopped booking Falcon 9 rideshare missions beyond late 2028, and an investor on Reddit calls that a gift to Rocket Lab. news.title: Mosaic Raises Funds for Robotic Surgery
news.summary: Anthropic said on Tuesday that it has launched its roadshow, a 7 to 10 day period ahead of an IPO in which a company pitches prospective institutional investors like mutual funds, pension funds and hedge funds. Interestingly, the tentative valuation the Claude-maker set, of between $1.26 trillion to $1.4 trillion, was slightly lower than what investors initially expected. (And, it’s also around the $1.25 trillion valuation that OpenAI recently raised $11 billion at, despite the fact that Anthropic generates more revenue. Meanwhile, the largest pure-play robotics company in the world by revenue and market cap is Intuitive Surgical , which makes the da Vinci Surgical System , a multi-armed contraption that human surgeons use on a remote-control basis to perform a variety of operations. But da Vinci was first unveiled over 25 years ago, and a new generation of robotics companies is aiming to further automate surgery by harnessing the latest advances in AI. news.title: Microsoft Dumps Oracle. Good News: Those Old Chips Renew at a “20% Premium”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft is winding down a 2023 deal to rent AI computing from Oracle because its older Nvidia chips no longer fit Microsoft’s specifications, Bloomberg reported. Oracle says GPUs renewed last quarter, mostly four years or older, went at a 20% premium, and IREN just recontracted older H100s at double the price.
news.title_zh: Microsoft 棄用 Oracle。好消息：舊晶片續約享有「20% 溢價」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：彭博社報導，Microsoft 正逐步終止一項向 Oracle 租用 AI 運算的 2023 協議，因其較舊的 Nvidia 晶片不再符合 Microsoft 規範。Oracle 表示，上季續約的 GPU 大多為四年或以上機齡，享有 20% 溢價，而 IREN 剛以雙倍價格重新簽約較舊的 H100s。

news.title: Only One Analyst Rates Oracle a Sell. What Does the Lone Bear See?
news.summary: Oracle keeps beating earnings estimates and Wall Street keeps cheering, yet the stock has slid hard this year. The lone skeptic points to a number that the bulls rarely mention, and it may explain why the market refuses to follow the consensus.
news.title_zh: 僅一位分析師將 Oracle 評為賣出。這位孤獨的空頭看到了什麼？
news.summary_zh: Oracle 持續超越盈餘預期，華爾街持續歡呼，但股價今年卻大幅下滑。這位孤獨的質疑者指出了一個多頭鮮少提及的數字，這可能解釋為何市場拒絕跟隨共識。

news.title: Oracle Lost a $7 Billion Tencent Deal and a Microsoft Contract in 3 Days: Sell, or Load Up?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft is winding down a 2023 deal to rent AI capacity from Oracle, two days after Oracle reportedly scrapped a $7 billion chip lease with Tencent. Oracle raised about $20 billion in stock and notes, using its entire funding cap through fiscal 2030 within five days of setting it.
news.title_zh: Oracle 失去一筆 $7 Billion 騰訊交易和一份微軟合約，耗時 3 天：賣出，還是加碼？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要微軟正在結束一筆 2023 向 Oracle 租用 AI 產能的交易，這是在 Oracle 據報取消與騰訊的 $7 billion 晶片租賃協議兩天後。Oracle 透過股票和票據籌集了約 $20 billion，在設定後五天內用盡了截至財政 2030 的整個融資上限。

news.title: Alphabet, Meta, and Oracle Are All Teaming Up to Disrupt Nvidia's Biggest Competitive Advantage
news.summary: The biggest factor locking customers into Nvidia chips -- the dominance of its proprietary CUDA software platform -- is under threat.
news.title_zh: Alphabet、Meta 和 Oracle 皆聯手打擊輝達最大競爭優勢
news.summary_zh: 將客戶鎖定在輝達晶片的最大因素——其專有 CUDA 軟體平台的主導地位——正面臨威脅。

news.title: Alphabet, Amazon and Meta Haven’t Bought Back a Share in 2026. Big Tech Buybacks Fell 90%
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCombined buybacks at Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta and Oracle fell to $4. 4 billion in the third quarter, 90% below their late-2021 peak, according to a tally by The Kobeissi Letter.
news.title_zh: Alphabet、亞馬遜和 Meta 在 2026 皆未回購一股。大型科技股回購下降 90%
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Alphabet、亞馬遜、微軟、Meta 和 Oracle 的合併回購額降至 $4。4 billion 在第三季，較其晚期-2021 高點低 90%，據 The Kobeissi Letter 統計。

news.title: The Stock Market Is “Petrified of Oracle’s Balance Sheet” as Microsoft Walks Away
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft is winding down a deal to rent AI computing power from Oracle, days after Oracle canceled an estimated $7 billion chip-leasing deal with Tencent. The Microsoft contract itself looks small, but losing it leaves Oracle’s backlog leaning even harder on OpenAI, which S&P says accounts for about half of it.
news.title_zh: 股市「懼怕甲骨文資產負債表」 微軟撤資
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要微軟正結束向甲骨文租用 AI 算力的協議，此前幾天甲骨文取消了估計 $7 billion 晶片租賃協議。微軟合約本身規模不大，但失去它使甲骨文的積壓訂單更加依賴 OpenAI，標普表示佔其約一半。

news.title: Microsoft Borrows at “10 Percentage Points Below CoreWeave.” Now It’s Backing Away From Neoclouds
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft wants fewer neocloud partners and won’t renew one of its cloud contracts with Oracle, CNBC reported on Friday. Citi’s Steven Wieting says Microsoft’s cost of debt is about 10 percentage points below CoreWeave’s.
news.title_zh: 微軟以「10 Percentage Points 低於 CoreWeave」借款。如今它正遠離新雲端
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：據 CNBC 週五報導，微軟想要較少的新雲端合作夥伴，且不會續約其一項與 Oracle 的雲端合約。花旗的 Steven Wieting 表示，微軟的債務成本約為 10 percentage points 低於 CoreWeave。

news.title: Microsoft reportedly winds down Oracle AI infrastructure contract
news.summary: Originally announced in 2023, the partnership provided Microsoft with access to Oracle servers to operate an AI-supported edition of its Bing search engine.
news.title_zh: 據報微軟正逐步終止甲骨文 AI 基礎設施合約
news.summary_zh: 該合作原於 2023 宣佈，讓微軟得以使用甲骨文伺服器，運行具 AI 功能的 Bing 搜尋引擎版本。

news.title: Oracle: Fewer Datacenter Permits Could Be A Good Thing
news.summary: Oracle looks undervalued as profitable AI data centers, EPS growth, and software strength offset debt concerns. Click here to read my latest analysis.

news.summary_zh: Oracle 看起來被低估，因為獲利的 AI 資料中心、EPS 成長和軟體優勢抵消了債務憂慮。點擊這裡閱讀我最新的分析。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysCipher Digital fell 20% in the week to Nov. 10, alongside CleanSpark and IREN, after Texas elected a governor who wants to pause new data centers.
news.title_zh: 「當我當選州長時這就會停止」：Cipher Digital 和 CleanSpark 一週內下跌近 20%
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Cipher Digital 在一週內下跌 20% 至 Nov. 10，連同 CleanSpark 和 IREN，在德州選出一位想要暫停新資料中心的州長後。

news.title: CRWV Stock Climbs 8% After-Hours As $132B Revenue Backlog Reinforces AI Compute Demand: NBIS, IREN Tick Higher
news.summary: The company’s revenue backlog stood at approximately $132.5 billion as of the end of the quarter, up from approximately $104.2 billion as of June 30.
news.title_zh: CRWV 股價盤後上漲 8%，因 $132B 營收積壓強化 AI 運算需求：NBIS、IREN 小幅上揚
news.summary_zh: 該公司的營收積壓截至季底約為 $132.5 billion，較截至 June 30 的約 $104.2 billion 有所增加。

news.title: IREN Sinks 10% as Analyst Target Cuts Pile Up After Microsoft Delay; Cipher Digital Falls 6%, TeraWulf Slides 2%
news.summary: A delayed Microsoft buildout and a $6 billion funding hole have analysts slashing IREN targets, and a hot inflation print is making it worse. Why are two rival miners holding up better, and what separates their models?
news.title_zh: IREN暴跌 10%，因微軟延遲導致分析師目標價下調累積；Cipher Digital下跌 6%，TeraWulf下滑 2%
news.summary_zh: 微軟建設延遲和 $6 billion 資金缺口導致分析師大幅下調IREN目標價，熱門通脹數據讓情況更糟。為何兩家競爭對手礦商表現較好，其模式有何不同？

news.title: JPMorgan Cut Its IREN Target to $55. It Still Sees 148% Upside
news.summary: Key TakeawaysJPMorgan cut its IREN price target to $55 from $65 on Monday and kept its Overweight rating, leaving 148% upside after a 68% drop in a year. IREN pushed its $4 billion revenue run-rate target into early 2027 after Microsoft asked for a network upgrade, and $6 billion of this fiscal year’s build still needs funding.
news.title_zh: JPMorgan 將 IREN 目標價下調至 $55。仍看好 148% 上漲空間
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要JPMorgan 週一將 IREN 目標價從 $65 下調至 $55，維持增持評級，在一年下跌 68% 後仍留有 148% 上漲空間。IREN 在微軟要求網路升級後，將其 $4 billion 營收運行率目標推遲至 2027 初，且本財年建設的 $6 billion 仍需資金。

news.title: Microsoft Dumps Oracle. Good News: Those Old Chips Renew at a “20% Premium”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft is winding down a 2023 deal to rent AI computing from Oracle because its older Nvidia chips no longer fit Microsoft’s specifications, Bloomberg reported. Oracle says GPUs renewed last quarter, mostly four years or older, went at a 20% premium, and IREN just recontracted older H100s at double the price.
news.title_zh: Microsoft 棄用 Oracle。好消息：舊晶片續約享有「20% 溢價」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：彭博社報導，Microsoft 正逐步終止一項向 Oracle 租用 AI 運算的 2023 協議，因其較舊的 Nvidia 晶片不再符合 Microsoft 規範。Oracle 表示，上季續約的 GPU 大多為四年或以上機齡，享有 20% 溢價，而 IREN 剛以雙倍價格重新簽約較舊的 H100s。

news.title: Could IREN Actually Climb 117%? Or Is Cantor Fitzgerald Totally Wrong?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysIREN stock is down 72% from its peak a year ago, and Cantor Fitzgerald cut its price target to $47 from $99 on Nov. 6 while keeping an Overweight rating.
news.title_zh: IREN 真的能漲至 117% 嗎？還是 Cantor Fitzgerald 完全錯了？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要IREN 股價較一年前高點下跌 72%，Cantor Fitzgerald 將目標價從 $99 下調至 $47，於 Nov. 6 維持增持評級。

news.title: IREN Falls 5% After Friday’s 20% Surge as AI Lending Worries Mount; TeraWulf and Applied Digital Rise 2%
news.summary: Banks are tightening the purse strings on AI data center debt, and not every former crypto miner is feeling the squeeze equally. One company owns its GPUs and carries billions in unfunded plans, while its peers lean on a different playbook.
news.title_zh: IREN 下跌 5%，此前週五飆漲 20%，AI 放貸憂慮升溫；TeraWulf 和 Applied Digital 上漲 2%
news.summary_zh: 銀行收緊 AI 資料中心債務融資，並非每家前加密貨幣礦商都同樣感受到擠壓。一家公司擁有自己的 GPU 並背負數十億美元未撥資金計畫，而其同業則採取不同策略。

news.summary: The AI boom isn't over yet.

news.summary_zh: AI 熱潮尚未結束。

news.summary: Today, Nov. 6, 2026, investors are weighing whether customer prepayments and contract wins can sustain the AI cloud momentum.

news.summary_zh: 今日, Nov. 6, 2026, 投資者正在權衡客戶預付款和合約獲勝能否維持 AI 雲端動能。

news.title: IREN CEO: Old Nvidia H100s Just Recontracted at “Double the Original Contract Price”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysIREN co-CEO Daniel Roberts said on the company’s Nov. 5 earnings call that older NVIDIA H100 GPUs were just recontracted at double their original contract price.
news.title_zh: IREN CEO：舊款 Nvidia H100s 剛以「雙倍原合約價格」重新簽約
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 IREN 共同執行長 Daniel Roberts 在公司的 Nov. 5 財報電話會上表示，較舊的 NVIDIA H100 GPU 剛以雙倍原合約價格重新簽約。

news.title: IREN Sinks 13% in a Week as Big Tech’s Results Rattle Neoclouds: “Already Popping”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysIREN (IREN) stock fell 13% from October 26 to November 2 as investors questioned how AI infrastructure companies would finance expansion. Microsoft (MSFT) reported delayed data center capacity, Cipher Digital (CIFR) generated $27 million in quarterly revenue, and Applied Digital (APLD) faced financing questions involving 800 MW.
news.title_zh: IREN 一週內下跌 13%，大科技財報震撼新雲端：「已經破裂」
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點IREN (IREN) 股價下跌 13%，從 October 26 降至 November 2，投資者質疑 AI 基礎設施公司如何為擴張融資。微軟 (MSFT) 報告數據中心產能延遲，Cipher Digital (CIFR) 季度營收達 $27 million，Applied Digital (APLD) 面臨涉及 800 MW 的融資問題。
